async def act(page):
    # Change 'View per page' to 100 to show more orders
    # Locate the combobox for 'View per page' in the pagination table (second table, first rowgroup, first cell)
    view_combobox = page.get_by_role("table").nth(1).get_by_role("rowgroup").get_by_role("row").first.get_by_role("cell").first.get_by_role("combobox")
    await view_combobox.select_option("100")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for table to update
    
    # Locate the orders table (fourth table in the tree)
    orders_table = page.get_by_role("table").nth(3)
    
    # Get all rows in the orders table
    rows = await orders_table.get_by_role("row").all()
    
    # Filter out header and filter rows
    data_rows = []
    for row in rows:
        row_text = await row.text_content()
        if row_text and any(keyword in row_text for keyword in ["Order #", "Purchased From", "Any", "Select Visible"]):
            continue
        data_rows.append(row)
    
    # Take the first 7 data rows as the most recent orders
    recent_rows = data_rows[:7]
    if len(recent_rows) < 7:
        return "Error: Less than 7 orders found."
    
    total_items = 0
    for i, row in enumerate(recent_rows):
        # Click the 'View' link in the last cell
        view_link = row.get_by_role("link", name="View")
        await view_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for order details page to load
        
        # On the order details page, find the items table
        # Look for a table with 'Product' or similar text
        items_table = page.get_by_role("table").filter(has_text="Product")
        if await items_table.count() == 0:
            items_table = page.get_by_role("table").first  # Fallback
        
        # Get all rows in the items table
        items_rows = await items_table.get_by_role("row").all()
        for item_row in items_rows:
            row_text = await item_row.text_content()
            if row_text and "Product" in row_text:
                continue  # Skip header row
            # Extract quantity from cells
            cells = await item_row.get_by_role("cell").all()
            for cell in cells:
                cell_text = await cell.text_content()
                if cell_text and cell_text.strip().isdigit():
                    total_items += int(cell_text.strip())
                    break
        
        # Go back to the Orders page
        await page.go_back()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for Orders page to reload
        # Re-locate the orders table after navigation
        orders_table = page.get_by_role("table").nth(3)
    
    return str(total_items)
